title: Kemuel
summary: Helper of God, or assembly of God. (1.) The third son of Nahor (Gen. 22:21).

inlines.v: Helper of God, or assembly of God. (1.) The third son of Nahor (Gen. 22:21).
(2.) Son of Shiphtan, appointed on behalf of the tribe of Ephraim to partition the land of Canaan (Num. 34:24).
